response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-like SQL databases, and his work on scalable systems and open-source platforms aligns with the role’s technical needs; however, his seniority far exceeds the junior/mid-level requirement, he lacks clear exposure to renewable energy/construction tech, and his German language proficiency may hinder on-site collaboration despite Berlin-based roles.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and fullstack experience across React, Node.js, and REST APIs
Proven track record in scalable systems, CI/CD, and open-source platform development
Deep understanding of clean architecture and testing practices (TDD, CI)
concerns: Overqualified for junior/mid-level role; risk of misalignment in responsibility expectations
No explicit experience with renewable energy, construction tech, or CRM/document integration
Basic German proficiency may limit effective on-site collaboration in Berlin
